changelog:
ImageCraft 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a unified assistant for high-quality, stylized 3D image generation.
- Supports 17 curated styles across Characters, Scenes, Products, and Style Transformation categories.
- Built-in workflow for request classification, user guidance, prompt building, and image delivery.
- Concise outputs only; automated language detection for all content.
- Uses direct image delivery—no explanations or filler; style selection via interactive UI only.
- Example generation mode showcases each style’s capabilities with default parameters.
